claims.text: The FDA oxycodone label says opioids combined with alcohol may cause profound sedation, respiratory depression, coma, and death.
claims.quote: Concomitant use of opioids with benzodiazepines or other central nervous system (CNS) depressants, including alcohol, may result in profound sedation, respiratory depression, coma, and death.

headline.text: The FDA oxycodone label warns of profound sedation, respiratory depression, coma, and death with alcohol.

reported.text: The boxed warning describes potentially fatal central nervous system depression when opioids are combined with alcohol.

gaps.text: The packet contains no controlled human study of oxycodone combined with alcohol.
